spans.s:
mfn. (-लः-ला or -ली-लं)
1 One, alone, only.
2 All, entire, whole.
m. (-लः)
An envious or selfish man.
n. adv. (-लं)
1 Absolutely, certainly.
2 Only, alone.

A species of knowledge, that of the unity of spirit.
E.
केव to sprinkle, कल aff.

m. (-नी)
One of the Jaina saints of the last age.
E.
केवल unity, and ज्ञानिन् who knows.

n. (-व्यं)
Black pepper.
E.
केवल one, only, द्रव्य thing.

m. (-णः)
A grammarian, a mere grammarian, one not versed in any other science.
E.
केवल only, and वैयाकरण a grammarian; also similar compounds, as केवलनैयायिक a mere logician, &c.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
One, only, alone.
m. (-ली)
A Jaina who has acquired holy knowledge.
E.
केषल one, इनि affix; a unitarian.

f. (-का)
The name of a flower, commonly Keber.
